verses.he: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מֶֽה־הָ֣יָה לָ֔נוּ הביט [הַבִּ֖יטָה] וּרְאֵ֥ה אֶת־חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us; Behold, and see our reproach.

verses.he: נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ נֶֽהֶפְכָ֣ה לְזָרִ֔ים בָּתֵּ֖ינוּ לְנָכְרִֽים׃
verses.en: Our inheritance is turned unto strangers, Our houses unto aliens.

verses.he: יְתוֹמִ֤ים הָיִ֙ינוּ֙ אין [וְאֵ֣ין] אָ֔ב אִמֹּתֵ֖ינוּ כְּאַלְמָנֽוֹת׃
verses.en: We are become orphans and fatherless, Our mothers are as widows.

verses.he: מֵימֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּכֶ֣סֶף שָׁתִ֔ינוּ עֵצֵ֖ינוּ בִּמְחִ֥יר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.en: We have drunk our water for money; Our wood cometh to us for price.

verses.he: עַ֤ל צַוָּארֵ֙נוּ֙ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ יָגַ֖עְנוּ לא [וְלֹ֥א] הֽוּנַֽח־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.en: To our very necks we are pursued; We labour, and have no rest.

verses.he: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ נָתַ֣נּוּ יָ֔ד אַשּׁ֖וּר לִשְׂבֹּ֥עַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: We have given the hand to Egypt, And to Assyria, to have bread enough;

verses.he: אֲבֹתֵ֤ינוּ חָֽטְאוּ֙ אינם אנחנו [וְאֵינָ֔ם וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ] עֲו‍ֹנֹתֵיהֶ֥ם סָבָֽלְנוּ׃
verses.en: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; And we have borne their iniquities.

verses.he: עֲבָדִים֙ מָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֔נוּ פֹּרֵ֖ק אֵ֥ין מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.en: Servants rule over us; There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

verses.he: בְּנַפְשֵׁ֙נוּ֙ נָבִ֣יא לַחְמֵ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.en: We get our bread with the peril of our lives Because of the sword of the wilderness.

verses.he: עוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ כְּתַנּ֣וּר נִכְמָ֔רוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י זַלְעֲפ֥וֹת רָעָֽב׃
verses.en: Our skin is hot like an oven Because of the burning heat of famine.

verses.he: נָשִׁים֙ בְּצִיּ֣וֹן עִנּ֔וּ בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.en: They have ravished the women in Zion, The maidens in the cities of Judah.

verses.he: שָׂרִים֙ בְּיָדָ֣ם נִתְל֔וּ פְּנֵ֥י זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א נֶהְדָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand; The faces of elders are not honoured.

verses.he: בַּחוּרִים֙ טְח֣וֹן נָשָׂ֔אוּ וּנְעָרִ֖ים בָּעֵ֥ץ כָּשָֽׁלוּ׃
verses.en: The young men have borne the mill, And the children have stumbled under the wood.

verses.he: זְקֵנִים֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר שָׁבָ֔תוּ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מִנְּגִינָתָֽם׃
verses.en: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

verses.he: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ לִבֵּ֔נוּ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְאֵ֖בֶל מְחֹלֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

verses.he: נָֽפְלָה֙ עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אֽוֹי־נָ֥א לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.en: The crown is fallen from our head; Woe unto us! for we have sinned.

verses.he: עַל־זֶ֗ה הָיָ֤ה דָוֶה֙ לִבֵּ֔נוּ עַל־אֵ֖לֶּה חָשְׁכ֥וּ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: For this our heart is faint, For these things our eyes are dim;

verses.he: עַ֤ל הַר־צִיּוֹן֙ שֶׁשָּׁמֵ֔ם שׁוּעָלִ֖ים הִלְּכוּ־בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, The foxes walk upon it.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֔ב כִּסְאֲךָ֖ לְדֹ֥ר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Thou, O LORD, art enthroned for ever, Thy throne is from generation to generation.

verses.he: לָ֤מָּה לָנֶ֙צַח֙ תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔נוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖נוּ לְאֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: Wherefore dost Thou forget us for ever, And forsake us so long time?

verses.he: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ ונשוב [וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה] חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃
verses.en: Turn Thou us unto Thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.

verses.he: כִּ֚י אִם־מָאֹ֣ס מְאַסְתָּ֔נוּ קָצַ֥פְתָּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עַד־מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: Thou canst not have utterly rejected us, And be exceeding wroth against us! Turn us unto Thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; Renew our days as of old.
